narrative: On the almanack. The almanac open at the day, one candle, a small cross in the margin. No name beside it. The night's leaf is not on this page. On the almanack. Blank paper under the mark. The pen is set down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set a small cross in the margin and left the rest of the page empty.

entities.name: almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in A cross, and no word
